strings.jp:
どうも、講師の田中陣八です。私が君ら素人に、前回まで
のあらすじ紹介を兼ねて、妖魔どもの特性について講義したいと思
う。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
生徒は、私の部下であり奴隷でもあるアルミ平くんと、秘
書兼、愛人と書いてラマンと読む、ひとみくんどもです。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
いつから僕が奴隷になったんですか！？　それに僕の名前
は鉄平です！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 私も愛人と書いてラマンじゃありません！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ええーい、うるさい！　お前らは黙って聞いてりゃいいん
だよ、このウジ虫どもがっ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 【鉄平＆ひとみ】
strings.note: a speaker's name, put before their messages: up to 16 letters

strings.jp: そ、そこまで言う‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
オホン！　エー、まず、前回のこの俺様の英雄的大活躍を
紹介する前に、あのバケモノども『妖魔』について、少し触れてお
かねばならないな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: エー、これが見ての通り、その妖魔に取り憑かれた女だ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
先生！　見ての通りって、見ても分かんないんですけど
‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ヤレヤレ、これだから素人は‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
いいか、妖魔に取り憑かれる女の特徴は、必ず美形である
ということだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
第２の特徴は、取り憑かれた女は、みな一様にして淫乱に
なるということだな。妖魔に取り憑かれた女たちは、その絶大なる
精力によって、軟弱な男どもを廃人にしてしまうわけだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
そして、俺様ほどのプロになると、匂いや妖気、雰囲気な
どで判断出来る。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: まぁ、とりあえず一発やっちまうのが簡単なんだがな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 先生、ちょっと下品です‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ゴホン！　アー、次にこのバカを見てほしい。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: あっ！　ディルサーラ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ハァ‥‥‥いつ見ても綺麗な方ですねぇ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
バカか、お前は？　このバカ笑い女に殺されそうになった
のを忘れたのか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: そ、そうでした‥‥‥すいません。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
いいか、これがみんな知っての通り、妖魔どものボス『バ
カ笑い女』だ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ディルサーラです、先生。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
そうとも言ったっけな‥‥‥まぁ、そのバカが出現したお
かげでバラバラだった妖魔どもは結束を固め、組織的な行動をとる
様になったわけだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: そして、こいつが第一に狙ったのは、この妖魔対策本部。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: しかし、情けないことに、僅か１ミリ秒で全滅した。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 全滅してません！　私が生き残りました！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
フン！　たかが秘書一人が生き残っとっても全滅と変わら
ん。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
その妖魔対策本部を立て直す為に、この有能な俺様に白羽
の矢が突き刺さったというわけだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ついでに生き恥をさらした、ひとみとオマケの新人、鉄平
が妖魔対策本部に加わったわけだがな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: どうせ私は生き恥ですよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
さて、このディルサーラが企んでいた真の計画とは、いっ
たいどんなものだったのか？　ステンレス平くん、答えてみなさい
。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
はい。ディルサーラは証券業界最大手の帝国証券の女社長
に取り憑き、第２のブラックマンデーを引き起こして日本経済の崩
壊を謀りました。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
さらに、不正に証券取引をしていた政治家たちのリストを
公表する事で、日本の政財界の転覆も企んでいました。ちなみに僕
の名前は鉄平です、先生。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: セリフが長くて生意気だが、正解だ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
しかし、このディルサーラの陰謀も、この英雄・陣八様の
活躍によって、帝国証券本社ビルとともに瓦礫とかしたわけだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
フン！　その英雄さんのおかげで、私たちまで妖魔対策
本部をクビになりましたけどね。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
まったくだ。ビルの２・３、フッ飛ばしただけでひとをク
ビにするとは、了見の狭い奴よ。だいたいお前らがクビになるのは
分かるが、なんで俺までクビにならにゃあならんのだ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: それはこっちのセリフです！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: なに？　台本のセリフを飛ばして読んだのか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: そういう意味じゃありません！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
まぁまぁ、先輩もひとみさんも落ち着いて下さい。とにか
く、あのディルサーラも瓦礫の下となり、死んでしまったんですか
ら‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 甘い！　コンデンスミルクを煮つめた様に甘いぞ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
あのバカ笑い女が簡単にくたばるわけがない。だいたい、
証券会社やくだらない政治家どもを、あいつが真剣に相手にするわ
けがない。

ホーホッホッホッホッ！‥‥‥‥‥‥誰がバカ笑

strings.jp:
お前だ、お前っ！‥‥‥たったいま、大笑いしてたじゃね

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

フン！　しかし、いつの間に入り込んだんだ？　だいたい

あいつらは？

ダメよ陣八くん、あんな雑魚じゃ。雑魚のくせに

strings.jp:

わ。

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

あら？　よく知ってるわね‥‥‥しかし、本当に
この娘たちには、まいったわよ。まさか、あのビルの爆発で、バク
タを封印する３つの鍵が、この娘たち３人に転移してしまうとは‥
‥‥‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

その３つの鍵がそろったとき、バクタが復活するってわけ

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
どうせ、お前が復活させようとしているモノだ‥‥‥‥‥

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
どうかしらね？‥‥‥‥‥‥さて、そろそろ行く

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ここで殺してあげてもいいのよ、陣八くん？

‥‥ゲホッゲホッ！　く、くるしぃ‥‥‥き、気管に‥‥‥‥‥‥
‥‥‥。

思わず、ふるえちまった。こんな敗北は初めてだぜ‥‥‥
まさかあいつが、短時間であそこまでパワーアップしているとは‥
‥‥‥‥‥いや、あいつは、秒ごとにパワーアップしているようだ
。

なんとかしないと‥‥‥‥‥‥しかし、そのためには、こ

‥‥‥アレは最後の切札だからな。しかもアレを使うと、こっちも

、それが巨大であれば、能力は半分以下じゃ‥‥‥‥‥‥分かるか
？

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ああ、だいたい‥‥‥‥‥‥。

どれどれ‥‥‥‥‥‥よしよし、なかなか似合ってる

う、うおぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉ！　な、なんだ、こり

strings.jp:
ウム、考えれば考えるほど、俺には反省する事など何も無
いな。良いことしかやった記憶がないしな。まるで天使の様だね、
俺は‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
強いて言えば、行いが良過ぎる事を反省するべきかな？
嫌みに感じる屈折した人間も居るからね。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 反省する事など、微塵も感じられない。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 数々の悪事って‥‥‥失礼なっ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 俺は悪事など一つもやった覚えはない！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
しかし、覚えがないというだけで、やっていないとは言っ
てない。その微妙なところを感じ取ってほしい。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
だいたい、いままで悪事の一つもした事が無い人間なんて
、人間じゃないか、本格派な偽善者だね。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
人間だれしも、人の一人や二人、殺してるんだから‥‥‥
ねぇ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
反省するほどの悪事なんかしてないぞ。俺はこう見える通
り、善人なんだから。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ディルサーラと、決着をつけるときがきた。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: なんだあの部屋は？　あれがバクタなのか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 対策本部もボロボロみたいだな‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: くそぉ、良子のやつ‥‥‥陰でコソコソ動きやがって。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: だんだんと、みんなつながってきたぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ＲＬＣってのは、クラブ活動みたいなもんか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ＲＬＣ‥‥‥ＲＬＣ‥‥‥ＲＬＣ‥‥‥‥‥‥ダメだ。何
も思い浮かばん！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
美樹までもがさらわれた。あいつら、何を企んでいるんだ
？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 山田花子か‥‥‥‥‥‥なんで偽名なんか使ってたんだ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
やはり妖魔による誘拐事件は起こってたか‥‥‥‥‥‥し
かし、その目的が分からん。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
クソ・ディルサーラめ！　やっぱり生きてやがったかっ！
！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ひとみと鉄平‥‥‥喧嘩でもしたのかなぁ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 山田花子か‥‥‥名前からして怪しいな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
妖魔どもは、美樹を本格的に狙い出したようだ。やはり、
誘拐しようとしているのか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 『ＡＢＢＡＲ』か？　またバー関係が、絡んでんのか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: あの野仲の母ちゃん‥‥‥なんか怪しいよなぁ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 妖魔が誘拐を‥‥‥なんのために？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ディルサーラは生きている。俺には分かるんだよ‥‥‥間
違いない。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
バクタの復活ねぇ‥‥‥‥‥‥だいたいバクタってなんだ
よ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
あいつら廃ビルでなにやってんだ？　とにかく廃ビルに行
ってみるか。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
妖魔ども、金持ちの娘にまで手を出し始めて、いったい何
をやらかそうってんだ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
何か起ころうとしている事は確かなんだが‥‥‥‥‥‥さ
ーて、何が起ころうとしているのかな？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
妖魔対策本部が動き出した‥‥‥良子に直接会って、確か
めてみるか。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 廃ビルを調べるか‥‥‥鉄平だけじゃ心配だしな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: さてね‥‥‥どうしたもんかね？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
嫌だけど、妖魔対策本部にでも行くか‥‥‥ひとみがうる
さいしな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 考えを整理するほど、まだ何も判っちゃいないよ。

えーと、ここが本部長室だっけ？　なんか俺が居たときと

オホン‥‥‥私は、妖魔対策本部本部長の秘書をしており
ます、松田と申します。

strings.jp:
可愛いんだけど、たいして重要なキャラじゃないみたい‥
‥‥。

これが秘書か‥‥‥フーン、なかなか可愛い顔をしてるじ
ゃないの。

strings.jp:
ん？‥‥‥おぉ！　よく見たら、この角度は凄いじゃない
か。胸の谷間を拝むには絶好のポジションだ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
‥‥‥‥‥‥見えん！　なんでネクタイなんか絞めてんだ
よ！？　だいたいシャツも邪魔だ！　脱げ！　いますぐ、そのシャ
ツを脱ぎさらせ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: な、なんなんです、突然！？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ええーい黙れ！　これからは素肌の上にジャケットを羽織
るんだ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: なんでそんな格好をしなければならないんです！？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: じゃあ、裸でエプロンだけするっていうのは？

a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: なっとくのため息だね。

strings.jp: 呆れてるんです！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ウーム、何度見ても、なかなか綺麗な顔の秘書だな。うち
の秘書である、ひとみに勝っているな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
でも、ショートカットで眼つきが鋭く気が強そうだな。そ
のへんは、ひとみの方が優しい性格をしているな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
身体は‥‥‥ウーム、この秘書の方が少し、ひとみよりは
良いみたいだな。乳もでかくて上を向いてるし‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ウム、この勝負、２対１で、君の勝ち。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
勝手に勝負させないでください。だいたい何ですか、その
採点は？　くだらない。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
冷たい対応をしやがって‥‥‥‥‥‥さては貴様、ミス・
コン反対派だな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 見た通り、気が強い秘書だ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: あいかわらず、綺麗だけが取柄の机だな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 机の上は‥‥‥ウム、なかなか綺麗に片付いているな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: それはどうも。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
いやそれがね、うちにも秘書が居るんだけど、そいつの机
がまた汚いんだよ。机そのものが汚いのもあるんだけどね。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ハァ‥‥‥それが？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: だから、その机を綺麗にしに来てよ。

strings.jp:
なんで私が、あなたの秘書の机を綺麗にしに行かなければ
ならないんですか？

strings.jp: いや何でって言われても‥‥‥理屈じゃないんだよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 理屈です。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
フン！　なんだよ。綺麗好きなんて、上辺だけのものだっ
たんだな、おまえは。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: なんで私が、そこまで言われなきゃならないんです？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 机の上には、コンピュータがあるな。

strings.jp: いじらないでください。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
いじらないよ。えーと、それから、消しゴムが１個あるな
。

strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 消さないよ‥‥‥‥‥‥お、シャーペンも１本あるぞ。

ピンチは当たってるけど、あとは全部ハズレね。

よ。

‥ええっ！？

。

そして立ち寄る行き付けの珈琲店。特製ブレンド珈琲の良

strings.jp:
それとも超伝導で浮いてるとか？　実はこの道路は磁石で
出来てるのかも？　フロッピーを落としたら、大変な事になるぞ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: まさに、ゲーム業界人キラー・ストリートだっ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ‥‥‥‥‥‥何を言ってるんだ、俺は？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: しかし、なんど見ても綺麗な道だね。嫌になっちゃうね。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
もうチリ一つないもの。なめれるくらいだよ‥‥‥いや、
実際なめて掃除しているのかもしれないぞ？　アメリカじゃ車を舌
で洗車した奴もいるくらいだからな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ‥‥‥‥‥‥なめてみるか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
もしかしたら、おいしいかもしれないぞ？　そう、だまさ
れたと思って‥‥‥‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own
a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ペロンとな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ぐわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁ！　ジャリジャリするぅ！
！　しかも、なんか口では表現出来ない凄い味だっ！！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ハァハァハァ‥‥‥‥‥‥だまされた。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
だまされるな。この道路は確かに綺麗だが、なめられるほ
どじゃないぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ちょっと、そこの人。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 私のことかな？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: あんたしかいないだろ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
おやおや、乱暴な口のお方だな。それで、この私に何の
用なのかな？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 別にこれといった用は無いんだがね‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
分かった。一度、金持ちと話してみたかったんだね？
いいだろう、いくらでも話してくれたまえ。さぁ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: さぁ、じゃねーよ。バカかお前‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
そんなに照れなくてもいいのだよ。だれしも私の様なお
金持ちと会話するときは、緊張するものだからねぇ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 緊張しねーよ。だいたいお前を見てる方が照れるよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
またまた憎まれ口をたたいて‥‥‥本当は誰よりも他人
（ひと）に愛されたいくせに‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
病気かお前は？　もういいよ。分かったから、あっち行っ
てくれ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
コラコラ、ダメだぞ。そんないつまでも殻に閉じ込もっ
てないで、さぁ、私の腕を取るのです。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: すぐに俺の前から消えねーと、俺の相棒が火を吹くぜ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
そんなオモチャなんか出して。寂しいんだね、ウンウン
。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: パン！（銃声）
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ヒ‥‥‥‥‥‥ヒィィィィィィィィィィィィィ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ヒィィィィじゃねーよ。クソ金持ちがっ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ちょっと、そこの人‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 【失礼な奴】
strings.note: a speaker's name, put before their messages: up to 16 letters

strings.jp:
ん？　僕かな？‥‥‥‥‥‥おや？　なんだいその服
装は？　今日、仮装パーティーでもあるのかい？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: なんだか、失礼な奴だな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
←ここにちゃんと書いてあるだろ？　僕はこう見えて
もね、失礼な奴なんだよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: こう見えてもじゃねーよ。充分そう見えるよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
僕の家系は代々、失礼な奴なんだよ。うちの先祖なん
か、ほとんどが他殺で、病死や事故死なんていないにひとしいのさ
。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: そ、それは確かに凄い‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
話は変わるけど、君って貧乏だろ？　見れば分かるさ
。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 突然、失礼な奴だな！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
だから言ってるだろ？　僕は代々、失礼な奴なんだっ
て。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ウゥ、そうだった。何も言えない‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
それじゃあ、君となんかと話してる時間がもったいな
いから、これで失礼させてもらうよ、貧乏人。あんまりこの辺をチ
ョロチョロするんじゃないよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ハ、ハァ‥‥‥
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥なんて失礼な奴なんだっ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: この辺には、ムカつく奴しか歩いてないぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: モーラ
strings.note: a menu's choice: up to max_cells letters

strings.jp: クビチョンパ
strings.note: a menu's choice: up to max_cells letters

strings.jp:
妖魔は美人に憑くのは当り前なんだが、そのほとんどが金
持ちでもあるんだ。つまりこの辺に妖魔がいる可能性は高いという
わけだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: という事で、ちょっと妖気をチェックしておこうか。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
妖気はまったく感じないが、金持ちの嫌な波動が、もの凄
く感じられる。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: オェ、妖気より気持ち悪りぃよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: どうせ何も感じないよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 一応、やってみるけどね‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ほら、何も感じない！　どうしてくれんだよ、俺の大切な
時をっ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 俺の時間を返せっ！　俺の青春を返せよっ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: お前のせいで、俺のお袋は‥‥‥お袋は‥‥‥‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
ふざけ過ぎて、収拾がつかなくなってしまった‥‥‥すま
ん。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ウーム‥‥‥‥‥‥やはり妖気は感じられない。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: とりあえずモーラで心を落ち着けよう。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥フゥ、この感触がたまらない。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
これをアソコに巻いたら‥‥‥さぞや気持ち良い事だろう
。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
‥‥‥‥‥‥フゥ！　なんて気持ち良いんだ。この新鮮な
快楽‥‥‥新たなる世界を発見したようだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
痛っ！　ちきしょう！！　モーラの紐が（ピー）に絡まっ
た！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
フゥ、危うく切り落とされるところだった‥‥‥可愛い顔
して、恐るべしモーラ‥‥‥‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
モーラか‥‥‥なつかしいな。まさかまだ売ってるとは思
わなかったよ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
最初にコレを見たときは、ＣＭの様にまるで生きたように
動くのかと思ってワクワクしたもんだが、テグスみたいなヒモが付
いているだけなのを知ってガッカリしたもんだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
しかし、原理はオーソドックスなステッキを浮かせる手品
とかと一緒なわけで、なれればかなりの動きを見せる事が出来る。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
だけどよく考えたら、子供には無理じゃないか、こんなテ
クニックを使うなんてなぁ‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: そうか！　モーラは大人のオモチャなのか！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
恐るべし大人のオモチャ・モーラ。俺はきっと、きみを忘
れない。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
モーラを使うのは楽しいんだが、いまはそれどころじゃな
い。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: よし！　クビチョンパを使うぞ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: クビチョンパ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ポンッ！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: クビチョンパッ！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: クビィーチョンパァッー！！
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ハァハァハァ‥‥‥‥‥‥あまり、おもしろくないぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: きみはクビチョンパを知っているだろうか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
その昔、エンピツをいっぱい買うともらえたのだ。しかも
ドリフのやつが‥‥‥しかも荒井注のまであったんだぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
それで、胴体の部分を強く握ると、ポンと軽快な音をたて
て首が飛んでいくという、ただそれだけのモノだったんだが。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: その後、似たようなモノが駄菓子屋で売っていたっけな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: いま考えると、何が楽しかったのか分からないな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ただ首が飛ぶだけだよ？　ポンッていって‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: いま考えると‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥楽しいな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
クビチョンパは、使い過ぎると胴体がつぶれて、クビが飛
ばなくなるぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 垂直跳びをする
strings.note: a menu's choice: up to max_cells letters

strings.jp: 反復横跳びをする
strings.note: a menu's choice: up to max_cells letters

strings.jp:
フフフフ‥‥‥俺はむかし、垂直跳びの達人と呼ばれた男
。あだ名も『Ｖ２ロケット野郎』と言われていたんだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
うちの学校の場合、バスケットゴールの横に垂直跳び計測
用の板が備え付けられていて、ガラガラと引っ張り下ろして計測し
ていたな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
まず板の真下に立って、腕を垂直にあげる。そして、その
手で板を押し上げる。これで身長差のハンデが無くなるという、い
たって単純な仕組みになっていたな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
そして指先にチョークの粉をつけて、ジャンプして板を触
るわけだ。いま考えると、なんて単純でマヌケなんだ。チョークの
粉ってところが、恥ずかしいな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
それですぐに板がチョークの粉で汚れるから、体育委員の
奴が黒板消しで、板を綺麗にするわけだな。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
この体育委員っていうのが、もう恥ずかしいな。持ってる
ものが黒板消しっていうのも、結構恥ずかしいぞ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
いやあ、なつかしい‥‥‥板に腕をぶつける奴とか、板を
押し上げるとき、腕を縮こませてインチキする奴とかいたなぁ。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: ハッ！‥‥‥‥‥‥いったい何の話をしているんだ？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: エッセイかよ、これは？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 垂直跳びは危険な技だ。だから止めよう。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: 反復横跳びをやるのか？
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp:
それじゃあ、たまたま持ちあわせたこのチョークを使って
、地面に線を引いてと‥‥‥。
strings.note: a message: any length (broken between words at max_cells letters, more windows for the rest); \n a new line; the speaker's name is a string of its own

strings.jp: まん中の線を跨いでスタートだったな。
